<a id="运行时默认能力"></a>
# Default runtime capabilities

[简体中文](capability-defaults.md) · **English**

<!-- Generated by tools/generate-capability-guide.mjs. -->

These values come from the packer’s default manifest configuration. A default does not establish implementation, authorization, or acceptance on every host.

**12 capabilities have no independent platform coverage records**

The APIs below are present in the default capability table but lack matching platform coverage entries in the inventory. No Web, mobile, or desktop support is inferred from a default value.

<a id="尚无逐平台覆盖记录的能力"></a>
## Capabilities without platform coverage records

- `wx.getRandomValues` — default: full
- `wx.hideTabBarRedDot` — default: partial
- `wx.offAppRoute` — default: partial
- `wx.offBeforeAppRoute` — default: partial
- `wx.offError` — default: partial
- `wx.onAppRoute` — default: partial
- `wx.onBeforeAppRoute` — default: partial
- `wx.removeTabBarBadge` — default: partial
- `wx.rewriteRoute` — default: partial
- `wx.setTabBarBadge` — default: partial
- `wx.setTabBarStyle` — default: partial
- `wx.showTabBarRedDot` — default: partial
